# The shortcuts container lazy loader reuses an existing element on sequential opens

Entry 1290 adds a loader that queries shortcuts-container, imports and appends it when missing, then calls open. The accepted ShortcutsOverlay module keeps that sequence and the component’s open method refuses a second showModal while already open. This supports sequential reopen behavior; the first query precedes an awaited import, so source alone does not prove concurrent first opens cannot create two elements. This is scoped lifecycle behavior with an unresolved concurrency limit. No dialog or concurrent-open test was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Customizable shortcuts loading.
